mintAuthority.summary: savUSD has one canonical native issuance route on Avalanche: immutable, deposit-only StakedAvUSDV2 share minting is bounded by deposited avUSD, while base avUSD issuance is the separately reviewed cap-limited AvantMintingV2 path. Cross-chain CCIP and LayerZero representation machinery is Bridge Risk only and is not counted as canonical Mint Authority.

controls.label: savUSD savings vault (StakedAvUSDV2, non-upgradeable)
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 96511220 on 2026-10-01, asset() returned avUSD 0x24de8771bc5ddb3362db529fc3358f2df3a0e346; owner() returned 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, owner) returned true. The correct EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. Routescan verified StakedAvUSDV2 source inherits ERC-4626 deposit-backed issuance and contains no upgrade entrypoint; redistributeLockedAmount burns an existing restricted balance before optionally minting the same shares to a new holder. Ethereum is a separate CCIP representation and is outside this canonical-vault finding.

controls.label: Inherited avUSD issuer mint authority
controls.capDescription: Underlying avUSD minting requires supported collateral, route and signature validation, and the AvantMintingV2 per-block cap; savUSD inherits that base-asset issuance path.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 96511220 on 2026-10-01, AvantMintingV2 avantcoin() returned avUSD 0x24de8771bc5ddb3362db529fc3358f2df3a0e346; maxMintPerBlock() and maxRedeemPerBlock() each returned 25000000000000000000000000 (25,000,000 avUSD at 18 decimals). owner() returned 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb and the correct EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots were zero. Verified source retains collateral, signature and route validation; this is the inherited base-asset issuer path, not an additional savUSD share mint path.

controls.label: Inherited avUSD gateway cap administrator
controls.capDescription: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can set maxMintPerBlock without a fixed upper bound on the inherited avUSD gateway; changing this parent cap does not bypass savUSD deposit-backed share issuance.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 96513662, gateway owner() returned this address, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, owner) returned true, avantcoin() identified avUSD 0x24de8771bc5ddb3362db529fc3358f2df3a0e346, and eth_getCode for this controller returned 0x. The gateway cap was 25,000,000 avUSD; verified setMaxMintPerBlock is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-gated and directly assigns the supplied uint256. This records inherited parent cap authority, not a new direct savUSD share minter; address-specific MPC key custody remains unverified.

review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-08-16: the official Avant registry identifies Avalanche 0x06d47f3fb376649c3a9dafe069b3d6e35572219e as the native Staked avUSD deployment and the other authored EVM deployments as bridged. At Avalanche block 92981175, the native wrapper returned avUSD as its asset, remained non-proxy and immutable, and its deposit-only share issuance was bounded by avUSD deposited. The separately reviewed avUSD parent establishes the sole cap-limited AvantMintingV2 base-asset path. Avalanche CCIP LockRelease and LayerZero adapter machinery, plus all destination representation minters, remain exclusively under bridgeRouteRisk and are not canonical Mint Authority.
